title: Jorjani's Persian grandmother talking to his long-dead grandfather while dying

tellings.quote: grandmother. And when she was dying, this exact thing happened. She starts talking to my dead grandfather.

plain: As she lay dying, Jason Jorjani's Persian grandmother began talking to his grandfather, who had been dead for years. Jorjani, a researcher, tells Michels he saw it happen: "She starts talking to my dead grandfather." He tells it as one example of the visions dying people are said to have, the kind that hint the dead may still be near.
